nodes.label: Brahmand — E2E Chain Execution Engine
nodes.rationale: Brahmand is the execution layer of the automated trading system. It runs a 5-agent sequential pipeline that transforms entry signals into live trades with continuous risk monitoring. Design trade-off: deterministic pipeline with LLM agent insights rather than fully autonomous; PAPER mode first with switchable LIVE path via Order Agent.

nodes.label: Antariksh — Orchestration + Signal Generation
nodes.rationale: Antariksh provides institutional oversight, entry signal generation, EMA computation, and reporting — separated from Brahmand's execution concerns to keep trading fast (5-min) and oversight slower (end-of-day).

nodes.label: order_agent.py — Centralized Order Hub
nodes.rationale: Centralized order routing hub: decides PAPER vs LIVE mode in one place via LIVE_MODE flag. Agents call place_entry_orders() and place_sl_tp_orders() but the CrewAI 'order_agent' entity is DEAD CODE (never used in any Task).

nodes.label: varaha_data.duckdb — Market Data Database
nodes.rationale: Contains market_data table (1-min candles with Greeks) and option_snapshots table (per-strike LTP, bid, ask, Greeks). Populated by data_capture_v3_duckdb.py and data_capture_v4_queue_aggregator.py.

nodes.label: state.db — SQLite Trade History
nodes.rationale: Two storage layers: JSON (data/brahmand_kickoff.json) for daily state + SQLite (state.db) for trade history, orders, monitoring for analytics.

nodes.label: entry_check.py — Entry Signal Generation
nodes.rationale: 100% deterministic entry signal scoring — no LLM calls at runtime, no DuckDB calls. Uses weighted combination of Trend (EMA) + Traffic Light (candlestick) + Feedback (research patterns) + modifiers (VIX, PCR, PriceLocation). Avoids DuckDB lock contention.

nodes.label: data_capture_v3.1 — 1-Min Bar Capture
nodes.rationale: Reads Shoonya WebSocket, computes 15 indicators every 60 seconds, pushes to Redis queue and DuckDB.

nodes.label: data_capture_v4 Queue Aggregator
nodes.rationale: Multi-TF aggregation (5/15/30/60/240/1440-min). On May 21, BLOCKING issue: doesn't call update_ema() on closed candles. Also integrated to call entry_check every 5 min.

nodes.label: Entry Agent (CrewAI)
nodes.rationale: Gate for CALL_SPREAD or PUT_SPREAD entry. Uses QueryTrendEMA and QueryTrafficLight tools. Output: {go: true/false, signal: BULLISH|BEARISH|NEUTRAL, confidence, ...}. NOT_UP and NOT_DOWN are two sub-flavors.

nodes.label: Regime Agent (CrewAI)
nodes.rationale: Validates entry signal against market regime using query_market_data tool. On May 20+, also calls query_entry_check tool to read deterministic entry signal, ensuring coherence between gate and LLM. No learning scope (validation only).

nodes.label: Strategy Agent (CrewAI)
nodes.rationale: Selects strategy (CALL_SPREAD/PUT_SPREAD/IRON_BUTTERFLY) and optimizes parameters (wing_width, sl_pct, tp_pct). Currently uses hardcoded rules; Postmortem Agent learns but feedback loop is broken — learning written to ChromaDB but not consumed.

nodes.label: Contract Agent (CrewAI)
nodes.rationale: Resolves exact option contracts (tsyms) from DuckDB option_snapshots. 100% deterministic lookup — no learning scope.

nodes.label: Execution Agent (CrewAI)
nodes.rationale: Builds trade dict and routes entry orders via PlaceEntryOrdersTool. Pure executor — no decisions of its own. Calls order_agent.place_entry_orders() via tool.

nodes.label: Risk Agent (CrewAI)
nodes.rationale: Places SL/TP orders via PlaceSLTPOrdersTool. In monitoring phase, runs 1-min cadence via DuckDB polling for TSL, OCO logic, exit signals. Enhanced with PatternQueryTool for RL-based adaptive SL/TP.

nodes.label: Morpher Agent (Monitoring)
nodes.rationale: Detects signal reversals and morphs position (e.g., BULLISH→NEUTRAL adds CALL_SPREAD). Tool-based detection via check_for_morph. MAX 3 morphs/day. Future enhancement: add SMC/Greeks/IV-based pre-emptive triggers.

nodes.label: Shifter Agent (Monitoring)
nodes.rationale: Premium decay detection — shifts legs to lock profit when decay hits thresholds (50% HEDGE_SHIFT, 60% SELL_SHIFT). Tool-based via check_for_shift.

nodes.label: Postmortem Agent (Post-Trade)
nodes.rationale: Only agent with HIGH learning scope. Analyzes all agent decisions vs outcomes, stores learnings in ChromaDB. BUT learning feedback to Strategy Agent is broken — insights written but not consumed. Runs end-of-day.

nodes.label: Trailing Stop Loss (TSL) Engine
nodes.rationale: Activates when profit ≥ 25% of max TP. Ratchets SL downward on favorable moves. Lock ratio controls portion of favorable ticks locked in. Only improves SL, never worsens. Enhanced with adaptive tsl_lock_ratio from patterns (P3.5).

nodes.label: PatternAnalyzer — 6-TF Pattern Recognition
nodes.rationale: 6-TF traffic light patterns (GRGRGG format: daily→4H→1H→30m→15m→5m). Forward outcome horizons: 5m, 15m, 30m, 1h, 4h, EOD, 1D. predict_live() returns pattern probabilities for adaptive risk.

nodes.label: PatternQueryTool — Risk Agent RL Tool
nodes.rationale: Calls PatternAnalyzer.predict_live() to fetch current pattern + outcome probabilities. Converts probabilities → actionable SL/TP parameters via _pattern_to_risk_guidance(). Wired as first risk agent tool.

nodes.label: order_ledger.json — Order-Level Tracking
